changelog: Live engine health and tachometer (RPM) with gear indicators.
6 distinct speedometer styles for cars (Classic, Realistic, Sport GT, Luxury, Cyber, Compact).
6 dedicated aeronautical instrument styles for airplanes (PFD artificial horizon, Six-Pack, Jet HUD, Minimal Aero, Transport, Retro).
6 dedicated instrument styles for helicopters (Glass MFD, Tactical FLIR, Analog dual-needle, Rescue SAR, Minimal Heli, Offshore).
Live in-game style selection and telemetry toggles in /hud and /conf_acn_hud.
